_comment: Personal-account profile: trades ETFs via IB fractional shares, reads vault_personal/, posts to personal Telegram channel. The 'sec_type' is still CONTFUT/STK for historical data fetching (we fetch futures candles for the underlying models), but position sizing uses the 'etf' mapping.

data._comment_ib_warmup: min/max both 500 so TWS always fetches 500×1D bars per symbol before cache upsert; personal run then overlays today's synthetic partial daily (15m) for predict.

execution._comment: Safety-gated IB auto-execution. Only used when --execute is passed. ib_account_id MUST match your paper account DUxxxxxxx. authorized_telegram_user_ids MUST list your personal Telegram user id (the bot will log rejects from any other id).
